description:
Experience the next generation of comfort and style with the upgraded 2025 sixthreezero Simple Step-Thru 20" E-Bike. Still compact and easy to ride, this new version now features a front suspension fork that absorbs bumps and uneven pavement, delivering a noticeably smoother and more comfortable ride—no matter where your day takes you.

Powered by a reliable 48V 500W motor, this eBike provides consistent, seamless power to help you glide through city streets, conquer hills, and cover more ground with less effort. Use pedal assist when you want a little boost, or hit the twist throttle for full electric power—reaching speeds of up to 20mph. The upgraded battery delivers up to 50 miles of range on a single charge, giving you freedom to roam without worrying about running low.

For improved safety and all-weather control, the 2025 model also features mechanical disc brakes, offering strong, reliable stopping power no matter the terrain. The integrated front and rear lights are now built in, so you’re always visible during early morning rides, evening cruises, or cloudy days—no extra setup needed.

The bike’s step-thru frame makes mounting and dismounting effortless, perfect for riders of all ages and abilities. The upright riding position reduces pressure on your back and shoulders, while the compact 20” wheels make it nimble and easy to handle in tight spaces.

Whether you’re commuting, running errands, or enjoying a weekend ride, the 2025 Simple Step-Thru 20" E-Bike gives you more comfort, more range, and more reasons to ride.

Key Features:

48V 500W Motor – Smooth, reliable power for daily riding

Up to 50 Miles of Range – Ride longer between charges

Front Suspension Fork – Absorbs bumps for a more comfortable, stable ride

Integrated Front & Rear Lights – Built-in visibility for added safety

Step-Thru Frame – Easy on and off for riders of all ages

20” Wheels – Compact and agile for city streets and bike paths

Pedal Assist + Twist Throttle – Choose how you ride

Top Speed of 20mph – Quick, efficient travel

Mechanical Disc Brakes – Strong, reliable stopping power in any conditions

Comfort-First Frame Geometry – Upright posture reduces strain on the body
